name: Sunsweet 100% Pure Prune Juice (WARNING)
whyItWorks: Naturally rich in concentrated sorbitol (a sugar alcohol polyol) and dihydrophenylisatin. A potent natural osmotic laxative that draws massive fluid volume into the intestinal lumen, causing agonizing cramps and profuse diarrhea in IBD.
prepOrOrderInstructions: AVOID during active Crohn's and Ulcerative Colitis. If constipation occurs in deep remission, discuss gentle osmotic laxatives like PEG-3350 with your gastroenterologist rather than drinking prune juice.
